# Genesis Trust Base

The Unicity Trust Base (UTB) defines the BFT validators used in the Unicity network.
All connected components in the Unicity network (Finality Gadget / BFT Node / Unicity Node)
share the same trust base. In Unicity Node, the genesis UTB is part of the genesis block defined in `chainparams.cpp`.

For testing purposes, the UTB is included in `trust-base.json` along with the BFT node
identities (private keys) used to generate it.

Currently, all networks (mainnet / testnet / regtest) share the same hardcoded UTB
defined in `chainparams.cpp`.
